name: Sweep & reclaim (fade) at last month's high / low with order flow
why: Stops cluster just beyond last month's high / low; aggressors who push through it and cannot hold beyond it (the 5-minute bar closes back inside) are trapped, and their exits plus the liquidity that absorbed them drive price back across the box. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md).

scan.when: flow && !rollwin && ((hi(5,1) > pmh && cl(5,1) < pmh && dsum(5,1) >= a*vsum(5,1)) || (lo(5,1) < pml && cl(5,1) > pml && dsum(5,1) <= -a*vsum(5,1)))
